TOPIC 4.2
Straight-Line Motion: 
Connecting Position, 
Velocity, and Acceleration

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-3.B
Calculate rates of change in 
applied contexts.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-3.B.1
The derivative can be used to solve rectilinear 
motion problems involving position, speed, 
velocity, and acceleration. 

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-3
Derivatives allow us to solve real-world problems involving rates of change.
